view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a warehouse aisle with polished concrete floors and industrial lighting. Stacks of palletized boxes are centrally located, while an orange forklift is partially visible on the right. Structural columns and safety barriers line the left side, with a numbered sign '2' overhead. A doorway reveals a brightly lit adjacent room.

objects.label: palletized boxes
objects.observation: Multiple stacks of dark blue boxes wrapped in plastic, resting on wooden pallets. Positioned centrally in the aisle, they appear organized and stationary. No visible supports other than the pallets themselves. They block part of the aisle's central path.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: Partially visible on the right edge, showing its orange and gray body with 'STILL' branding. The vehicle is parked or stationary near yellow safety barriers. Its forks are not visible, suggesting it may be idle or loaded. It occupies the foreground right.

objects.label: yellow safety barriers
objects.observation: Yellow horizontal rails mounted on black posts, running along the left side of the aisle. They appear to delineate walkways or restrict access. Some are near the camera’s left edge, others further down the aisle. They are freestanding and supported by their posts.

objects.label: ceiling-mounted light fixtures
objects.observation: Long, rectangular fluorescent lights suspended from the ceiling. They illuminate the aisle evenly, casting reflections on the floor. Located above the central aisle and extending toward the background. They are visibly attached to the ceiling structure.

objects.label: numbered sign
objects.observation: White square sign with black number '2', mounted high on the wall or ceiling. Positioned above the central aisle, near the left side. It appears to indicate an aisle or zone number. It is affixed to a structural element.

objects.label: doorway
objects.observation: Rectangular opening in the white wall, revealing a brightly lit interior space. Inside, red furniture or equipment is faintly visible. The doorway is framed by the wall and provides a view into another area. It is structurally integrated into the wall.

You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s4-32850", "image_size": [1920, 1080], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
